title: video/storyboard.json
description: What the result part of the preview video shows, decided before anything is built. Written by the storyboard AI.

value.description: One plain sentence: what a viewer should take away about the skill.

pattern.description: The starting pattern from style.md, or custom.

shots.description: One to three moments, in order, inside the 6-second result window.

asset.description: A file in media/, for example media/hero.jpg.

show.description: What part of the asset to show and how it moves.

caption.description: Plain words on screen, at most 6 words. Empty for no caption.

cover.description: Which moment makes the best still cover.

notes.description: Anything the author should know: what to avoid, what is impressive.
